primary_statistic: H1 interaction on log mean end-to-end latency, steady-state points

bootstrap.method: repeats resampled jointly across policies, then a circular block bootstrap over arrival positions shared by every policy and repeat

steady_state_rule: transient when last-third mean over first-third mean >= 1.1 and its 95% interval excludes 1
slo_reference: fastest pool node's concurrency-1 cost-model cell for the request's bucket

load_trend_queue_aware.reading: H1's load clause predicts the queue-aware gain shrinks with load: change_ms below zero, change_in_ratio above one
